name: What is the difference between shoe molding and quarter round?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between shoe molding and quarter round?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shoe molding and quarter round are both types of trim used to cover gaps between flooring and baseboards, but they differ in profile. Quarter round has a perfect 90-degree angle on the back with a quarter-circle radius on the front. Shoe molding, by contrast, is taller and less 'round,' featuring a slightly flatter profile that is often considered more elegant and less obtrusive. A practical tradeoff is that shoe molding typically appears more subtle and can be more forgiving with slight floor imperfections, while quarter round offers a more pronounced, rounded edge.
acceptedAnswer.description: Shoe molding is taller and less round than quarter round, offering a more subtle profile to cover floor gaps.
